verdict.rationale: Lium's pod-creation docs include its own toggle to get a Jupyter notebook on the pod, which covers the Jupyter half of the story in essentially one step. Nothing in the evidence shows a VS Code or Cursor remote/IDE connection flow, and the Jupyter feature is documented only by a single line with no detail on how it is opened or accessed. Missing for 10: documented one-step VS Code/Cursor IDE connection, detail on how the Jupyter URL is opened or accessed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open Jupyter or connect my IDE (VS Code/Cursor) to the instance in one step

citations.quote: Turn it on to get a Jupyter notebook on the pod.
